definitions.explanation: Making something larger in size, especially an image or text.
Increasing the scope, range, or scale of something.

⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拡大|かくだい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
{拡大|かくだい} means enlargement or expansion. It can refer to physical magnification or abstract growth.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Both transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}) and intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Transitive: [noun]を{拡大|かくだい}する
- Intransitive: [noun]が{拡大|かくだい}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {拡大|かくだい}する (to enlarge, to expand)
- {拡大|かくだい}{表示|ひょうじ} (enlarged display, zoom)
- {拡大|かくだい}{解釈|かいしゃく} (broad interpretation)
- {拡大|かくだい}{再生産|さいせいさん} (expanded reproduction)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- Technology: {画面|がめん}を{拡大|かくだい}する (zoom in on screen)
- Business: {事業|じぎょう}{拡大|かくだい} (business expansion)
- Abstract: {影響|えいきょう}が{拡大|かくだい}する (influence expands)

ANTONYM:
- {縮小|しゅくしょう} (reduction, shrinking)
